blocks.text: Har jandar ki zindagi ki kuch zaroortein hain jo woh doosre jandaron aur tabeei mahol se amal kar ke poori karta hai. Ecology jandaron ke doosre jandaron aur mahol se rishton ka mutala hai. Yeh chapter mahol ke bunyadi tasawwurat aur mahol aur jandaron ke darmiyan maadde aur tawanai ke chakkar ke baare mein hai.
Zindagi ka kaam samajhne ke liye hum un darjon ko dekhte hain jin par qudrati duniya munazzam hai, yaani barhti paicheedgi ki tehein.

blocks.prompt: Ecology kis cheez ka mutala hai?
blocks.explanation: Jandaron ke doosre jandaron aur apne mahol se rishte.

items: Ecology: jandaron ke aapas aur mahol se rishte.
Fitrat barhti paicheedgi ke darjon mein munazzam hai.
